name: manager-global-search
title: Upgrade manager global search and deep navigation
description: Index permission-scoped manager pages and nested functions, show breadcrumbs, and deep-link search results to the correct page/tab.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Root cause: the header search indexes only top-level pages and directly changes currentPage, so nested destinations and query/tab context cannot be represented or opened. Preserve allowedPages permission filtering and use the existing manager:navigate contract.
